svg.title: One frame's sprite list
svg.desc: One frame of Vale with each of its nine sprite list entries outlined. Each entry is one rectangle of picture the console draws over the backgrounds, in one of a few fixed sizes. The four people are each a 32 by 32 pixel entry with a 16 by 8 entry for the shadow under their feet, eight entries in all, and the stone pillar is one tall entry, 32 by 64. The girl at the left edge is partly off the screen, so her entry is cut off there. Below, the three people in the middle closer up: their entries overlap, and the order of the list decides which is drawn in front.
svg.text: CLOSER: THE THREE IN THE MIDDLE
